verdict.rationale: Render documents workflow tasks that can be defined and triggered from TypeScript and Python code through its SDKs, and it supports background processes. However, nothing in the pack shows a recurring or cron-style scheduler, so recurrence would apparently need an external trigger. Missing for 10: documented cron/recurring schedule configuration for jobs or workflows, a way to declare schedules in render.yaml/CLI/API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled execution.
